top_signals.title: Anterix Could Be SpaceX’s Next Deal for Mobile Network Access
top_signals.summary: In SpaceX’s insatiable hunt for wireless spectrum as it marches toward becoming a full-fledged mobile service provider, there’s a likely motherlode in its sights: Anterix Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
